data.description: The inventory is the pop-up menu that the player uses to manage items they carry. From this screen a player can equip armor, craft items on a 2×2 grid, and equip tools, blocks, and items. The player's skin is also displayed here.

<p>The <b>inventory</b> is the pop-up menu that the player uses to manage items they carry. From this screen a player can equip <a href="/w/Armor" title="Armor">armor</a>, <a href="/w/Craft" class="mw-redirect" title="Craft">craft</a> items on a 2×2 grid, and equip <a href="/w/Tool" title="Tool">tools</a>, <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a>, and <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">items</a>. The <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s <a href="/w/Skin" title="Skin">skin</a> is also displayed here.
</p>

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Overview">Overview</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=1&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Overview" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=1" title="Edit section's source code: Overview"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>The inventory is opened and closed by pressing <kbd class="key nowrap">E</kbd> (<span typeof="mw:File"><span title="Y button"><img alt="Y button" src="/images/thumb/XboxOne_Y.png/25px-XboxOne_Y.png?7adbf" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/XboxOne_Y.png/50px-XboxOne_Y.png?7adbf 2x" data-file-width="100" data-file-height="100"></span></span> on the Xbox 360 & Xbox One, <span typeof="mw:File"><span title="Triangle button"><img alt="Triangle button" src="/images/thumb/PS_Triangle.png/25px-PS_Triangle.png?d3cb5" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/PS_Triangle.png/50px-PS_Triangle.png?d3cb5 2x" data-file-width="100" data-file-height="100"></span></span>/<span typeof="mw:File"><span title="Triangle button"><img alt="Triangle button" src="/images/thumb/PS5_Triangle.png/25px-PS5_Triangle.png?d465a" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/PS5_Triangle.png/50px-PS5_Triangle.png?d465a 2x" data-file-width="100" data-file-height="100"></span></span> on the PlayStation 3, PlayStation Vita, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5, <span typeof="mw:File"><span title="X Button"><img alt="X Button" src="/images/thumb/WiiU_X.png/25px-WiiU_X.png?39c08" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/WiiU_X.png/50px-WiiU_X.png?39c08 2x" data-file-width="100" data-file-height="100"></span></span> on the Wii U & Nintendo Switch, and ••• on mobile devices). This key can be changed from the in-game <a href="/w/Controls" title="Controls">options</a> menu. The inventory can also be closed with <kbd class="key nowrap">⎋ Escape</kbd> (<span typeof="mw:File"><span title="B button"><img alt="B button" src="/images/thumb/XboxOne_B.png/25px-XboxOne_B.png?4b5b5" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/XboxOne_B.png/50px-XboxOne_B.png?4b5b5 2x" data-file-width="100" data-file-height="100"></span></span> on the Xbox 360, Xbox One, Wii U, and Nintendo Switch, <span typeof="mw:File"><span title="Circle button"><img alt="Circle button" src="/images/thumb/PS_Circle.png/25px-PS_Circle.png?fc8ab" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/PS_Circle.png/50px-PS_Circle.png?fc8ab 2x" data-file-width="100" data-file-height="100"></span></span>/<span typeof="mw:File"><span title="Circle button"><img alt="Circle button" src="/images/thumb/PS5_Circle.png/25px-PS5_Circle.png?586e1" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="25" height="25" class="mw-file-element" srcset="/images/thumb/PS5_Circle.png/50px-PS5_Circle.png?586e1 2x" data-file-width="100" data-file-height="100"></span></span> on the PlayStation 3, PlayStation Vita, PlayStation 4 and PlayStation 5, and × on mobile devices).
</p><p>The inventory is saved upon exiting a world or server, so the player retains exactly the same items upon re-entering the world or server. 
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Slots">Slots</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=2&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Slots" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=2" title="Edit section's source code: Slots"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux">See also: <a href="/w/Slot" title="Slot">Slot</a> 
</div>
<p>The inventory consists of 4 armor slots, 27 storage slots, 9 hotbar slots, and an <a href="/w/Off-hand" class="mw-redirect" title="Off-hand">off-hand</a> slot. Items in the hotbar slots can be selected using the keyboard keys (<kbd class="key nowrap">1</kbd>–<kbd class="key nowrap">9</kbd>) or by moving the <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Scroll_wheel.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Scroll_wheel.png?90ac0" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Scroll Wheel. Pressing the <kbd class="key nowrap">F</kbd>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">JE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> key moves the selected item to and from the hotbar slot and the <a href="/w/Off-hand" class="mw-redirect" title="Off-hand">off-hand</a> slot.
</p><p>Most items stack up to 64, while some items stack to 16, like many <a href="/w/Projectiles" class="mw-redirect" title="Projectiles">projectiles</a>, or do not stack at all, like items with <a href="/w/Durability" title="Durability">durability</a>. All items can stack up to 99‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">JE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> or 127‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Bedrock Edition"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition" title="Bedrock Edition">BE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> using <a href="/w/Data_component_format" title="Data component format">components</a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">JE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> or commands.
</p>

<p>There is also a 2×2 <a href="/w/Crafting" title="Crafting">crafting</a> grid, which allows any recipe that fits to be crafted but does not offer item storage. This is not available in Creative or Spectator mode in <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>.
</p><p>Armor is considered equipped only when it is in an armor slot; when in any of the regular inventory slots, it is not considered "worn" and does not offer protection. Held armor can be equipped by <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">using</span> it, exchanging it with any armor already occupying that slot.
</p><p>Items have tooltips if the cursor is hovered over them, displaying their name, <a href="/w/Enchantment" title="Enchantment">enchantments</a>, lore, and some item-specific information such as the version of a <a href="/w/Written_book" class="mw-redirect" title="Written book">written book</a>. <a href="/w/Debug_screen#More_debug-keys" title="Debug screen">Pressing <kbd class="key nowrap">F3</kbd> + <kbd class="key nowrap">H</kbd></a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">JE</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> causes items to display additional information, such as their ID, <a href="/w/Data_values" class="mw-disambig" title="Data values">data values</a>, and some item specific information.
</p><p>Pressing <span class="explain" title="Defaults to right click on mouse or left trigger on controller.">use</span> on a block with an inventory, such as a <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chest</a>, <a href="/w/Crafting_table" class="mw-redirect" title="Crafting table">crafting table</a>, or a <a href="/w/Furnace" title="Furnace">furnace</a> opens its GUI and allow items to be transferred between the 27 main slots, the 9 hotbar slots, and the block's GUI.
</p><p>The only available slots for setting attributes are "mainhand", "offhand", "head", "chest", "legs", and "feet".
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Recipe_book">Recipe book</h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=3&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Recipe book" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=3" title="Edit section's source code: Recipe book"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux">Main article: <a href="/w/Recipe_book" title="Recipe book">Recipe book</a></div>
<p>The recipe book has a catalog of all the <a href="/w/Recipe" class="mw-disambig" title="Recipe">recipes</a> in the game and serves as a <a href="/w/Crafting" title="Crafting">crafting</a> guide. It shows every crafting recipe that the player has had materials for.
</p><p>Crafting recipes are organized into different categories in the recipe book through the different tabs. In <i>Java Edition</i>, the categories are:

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Managing_inventory">Managing inventory</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=4&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Managing inventory" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=4" title="Edit section's source code: Managing inventory"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Stacks can be grabbed as a whole by pressing left-click on the stack and can be split in two by pressing right-click. If the stack is an odd quantity, then it leaves the smaller half behind (for example, a stack of 7 grabs 4 items and leaves 3 in the slot). Conversely, holding a stack of items in the player's cursor and left-clicking in an inventory slot places the full stack into the slot and right-clicking places items one at a time. If there is already a stack in that slot, it gets swapped with the grabbed stack. Double-clicking an item grabs up to a full stack from all the items within the inventory.
</p><p>Holding <kbd class="key nowrap">⇧ Shift</kbd> and clicking on a stack sends the stack from the <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s hotbar to the player's 27 inventory slots or vice versa, in order from left to right, then top to bottom. Doing so while an external inventory (chest boat, dispenser, etc.) is open sends the item stack from the player's inventory into the external inventory (from left to right, top to bottom) or vice versa (from bottom to top, right to left, starting with hotbar slot 9). Holding <kbd class="key nowrap">⇧ Shift</kbd> and double-clicking a stack while having an external inventory open and holding another stack moves all items that are identical to the clicked stack between the player's inventory and the external one (in the same order as regular shift-clicking). Doing so with only the internal inventory open instead collects all items of that type in the top-left most available inventory slot (not hotbar, so doing this with 0 free inventory slots leaves the items where they are). <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Left_mouse_button.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Left_mouse_button.png?485a7" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Left Mouse Button, <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Right_mouse_button.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Right_mouse_button.png?cd132" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Right Mouse Button and Shift in all of these controls are independent of the keybinds menu and cannot be changed.
</p><p>Hovering over an inventory slot and pressing (by default) <kbd class="key nowrap">1</kbd>–<kbd class="key nowrap">9</kbd> switches the item in that inventory slot with the item in that slot of the hotbar, or moves the item from one to the other if either slot is empty. In <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, pressing <kbd class="key nowrap">F</kbd> behaves similarly, but with the <a href="/w/Off-hand" class="mw-redirect" title="Off-hand">off-hand</a> slot.
</p><p>Dragging a stack of items with the cursor over an inventory using <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Left_mouse_button.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Left_mouse_button.png?485a7" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Left Mouse Button divides the stack equally over the dragged-over slots (with the remainder staying on the cursor), whereas dragging the stack around using <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Right_mouse_button.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Right_mouse_button.png?cd132" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Right Mouse Button places one item of that stack in each dragged-over slot. Regardless of whether <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Left_mouse_button.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Left_mouse_button.png?485a7" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Left Mouse Button or <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Right_mouse_button.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Right_mouse_button.png?cd132" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Right Mouse Button is used, this occurs only with slots that are empty or contain identical items. If this amount of items does not fit onto the stack anymore, the rest stays on the cursor.
</p><p>In <a href="/w/Creative" title="Creative">Creative</a> mode, (by default) middle-clicking a slot in an inventory grabs a full stack of the item while leaving the item in the slot. Dragging items with the cursor while holding the <span class="pixel-image" typeof="mw:File"><a href="/w/File:Middle_mouse_button.png" class="mw-file-description"><img src="/images/Middle_mouse_button.png?de253" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="24" height="24" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="16" data-file-height="16"></a></span> Middle Mouse Button places a full stack of the item in each dragged-over slot.‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Java Edition"><a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition">Java Edition</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> This dragging action does not work if the "pick block" key is rebound.<sup id="cite_ref-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-1"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>1<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</p><p>Pressing (by default) <kbd class="key nowrap">C</kbd>+<kbd class="key nowrap">1–9</kbd> (hold down <kbd class="key nowrap">C</kbd> while pressing <kbd class="key nowrap">1-9</kbd>) in Creative mode saves the current toolbar in the <a href="/w/Saved_hotbars" class="mw-redirect" title="Saved hotbars">Saved hotbars</a> tab. It can be loaded (by default) with <kbd class="key nowrap">X</kbd>+<kbd class="key nowrap">1-9</kbd>.
</p><p>Pressing <span class="explain" title="Defaults to Q on keyboard or D-pad down on controller.">drop</span> while the cursor is hovering over a slot in the player's inventory or a container's inventory drops one item. Holding <kbd class="key nowrap">⎈ Control</kbd> and pressing <span class="explain" title="Defaults to Q on keyboard or D-pad down on controller.">drop</span> while hovering over a slot in the player's inventory or container's inventory that has one or more items drops the entire stack of items. Without an inventory open, the same can be applied for the selected item(s) from the hotbar. The Ctrl key is not rebindable for these actions. Items can also be dropped into the world by clicking outside the inventory window while holding an item with the cursor.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Creative_inventory">Creative inventory</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=5&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Creative inventory" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=5" title="Edit section's source code: Creative inventory"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux">Main article: <a href="/w/Creative_inventory" title="Creative inventory">Creative inventory</a></div>
<p>In <a href="/w/Creative" title="Creative">Creative</a> mode, the inventory contains a block selection menu containing all blocks and items found in survival, plus a few additional items not obtainable in Survival. The blocks and items are organized into various tabs that differ slightly between <i>Java</i> and <i>Bedrock</i>.
</p>
<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="External_inventories">External inventories</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=6&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: External inventories" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=6" title="Edit section's source code: External inventories"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<div role="note" class="hatnote searchaux"><span typeof="mw:File"><span><img alt="" src="/images/Disambig_color.svg?2db52" decoding="async" loading="lazy" width="12" height="9" class="mw-file-element" data-file-width="444" data-file-height="340"></span></span> "Container" redirects here.  For the item component in <a href="/w/Java_Edition" title="Java Edition"><i>Java Edition</i></a>, see <a href="/w/Data_component_format#container" title="Data component format">Data component format § container</a>.</div>
<p>Many blocks and some non-player entities have their own inventory-like menus that pop up to allow manipulation of items.

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading2"><h2 id="Mob_inventory">Mob inventory</h2><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=9&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Mob inventory" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=9" title="Edit section's source code: Mob inventory"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<p>Certain <a href="/w/Mob" title="Mob">mobs</a> have inventory slots, used for various purposes.
</p>
<ul><li><a href="/w/Villager" title="Villager">Villagers</a> have 8 slots, not accessible to the player, which they use to collect various <a href="/w/Villager#Picking_up_items" title="Villager">farming-related seeds and foods</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Piglin" title="Piglin">Piglins</a> have 8 slots, not accessible to the player, which they use to collect various <a href="/w/Piglin#Picking_up_items" title="Piglin">items</a>.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Pillager" title="Pillager">Pillagers</a> have 5 slots, not accessible to the player, which goes unused, as pillagers don't change their inventory automatically or drop items from it upon death.<sup>[<i><a href="/w/Talk:Pillager" title="Talk:Pillager">more information needed</a></i>]</sup></li>
<li><a href="/w/Agent" title="Agent">Agents</a>‌<sup class="nowrap Inline-Template" title="">[<i><span title="This statement only applies to Minecraft Education"><a href="/w/Minecraft_Education" title="Minecraft Education">Minecraft Education</a>  only</span></i>]</sup> have 27 slots that are accessible to the player by a GUI, and can be accessed by the agent according to its programming.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Donkey#Equipment" title="Donkey">Donkeys</a> and mules, when equipped with a <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chest</a>, have 15 inventory slots accessible to the player.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Llama" title="Llama">Llamas</a> and <a href="/w/Trader_llama" class="mw-redirect" title="Trader llama">trader llamas</a>, when equipped with a chest, have 3, 6, 9, 12 or 15 inventory slots, corresponding to their <code>Strength</code> stat.</li>
<li><a href="/w/Allay" title="Allay">Allays</a> have 1 inventory slot, not accessible to the player, which they use to collect items that match a <a href="/w/Allay#Behavior" title="Allay">player given held item</a>.</li></ul>

</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>The <a href="/w/Crafting" title="Crafting">crafting</a> menu can now be opened by pressing a hotkey.<sup id="cite_ref-Nizzotch_4-1" class="reference"><a href="#cite_note-Nizzotch-4"><span class="cite-bracket">[</span>3<span class="cite-bracket">]</span></a></sup>
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">

</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">

<div class="mw-heading mw-heading3"><h3 id="Bedrock_Edition_2"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></h3><span class="mw-editsection"><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">[</span><a href="/w/Inventory?section=13&veaction=edit" title="Edit section: Bedrock Edition" class="mw-editsection-visualeditor"><span>edit</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-divider"> | </span><a href="/w/Inventory?action=edit&section=13" title="Edit section's source code: Bedrock Edition"><span>edit source</span></a><span class="mw-editsection-bracket">]</span></span></div>
<link rel="mw-deduplicated-inline-style" href="mw-data:TemplateStyles:r3751077"><table class="wikitable pixel-image" data-description="History"><tbody><tr class="collapsible collapsible-rows"><th class="historytable-subheader" colspan="8" style="border-bottom: none"><span class="collapsetoggle" style="min-width: 40.4688px;">[<span class="jslink" tabindex="0">hide</span>]</span><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_Alpha" title="Pocket Edition Alpha">Pocket Edition Alpha</a></th></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.1.0_alpha" title="Pocket Edition v0.1.0 alpha">v0.1.0</a></th>
<td>Unlimited <a href="/w/Block" title="Block">blocks</a> can now be placed from the <a href="/w/Player" title="Player">player</a>'s inventory.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="3" colspan="7"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.2.0_alpha" title="Pocket Edition v0.2.0 alpha">v0.2.0</a></th>
<td>The previous inventory is now used in <a href="/w/Creative" title="Creative">Creative</a> mode.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>Added the <a href="/w/Survival" title="Survival">Survival</a> inventory. The player can still see the blocks as though in Creative mode, but cannot use them unless they have gathered the respective material.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>As <a href="/w/Crafting" title="Crafting">crafting</a> has not yet been implemented, the player now spawns with infinite quantities of normally craftable <a href="/w/Item" title="Item">items</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.3.0_alpha" title="Pocket Edition v0.3.0 alpha">v0.3.0</a></th>
<td>The Survival mode inventory now includes a 2×2 crafting grid.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="7"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.6.0_alpha" title="Pocket Edition v0.6.0 alpha">v0.6.0</a></th>
<td>Armor tab has been added into the Survival inventory.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="2" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.9.0_alpha" title="Pocket Edition v0.9.0 alpha">v0.9.0</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="2"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.9.0_alpha_build_1" title="Pocket Edition v0.9.0 alpha build 1">build 1</a></th>
<td>The <a href="/w/Survival" title="Survival">Survival</a> inventory has been redesigned to match it to the Creative inventory.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td><a href="/w/Crafting" title="Crafting">Crafting</a> grids now show craftable recipes, with the 2×2 or 3×3 grid showing the recipe.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.11.0_alpha" title="Pocket Edition v0.11.0 alpha">v0.11.0</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_v0.11.0_alpha_build_1" title="Pocket Edition v0.11.0 alpha build 1">build 1</a></th>
<td>The inventory texture in the <a href="/w/Survival" title="Survival">Survival</a> inventory has been changed from a <a href="/w/Brick" title="Brick">brick</a> to a <a href="/w/Chest" title="Chest">chest</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible collapsible-rows"><th class="historytable-subheader" colspan="8" style="border-bottom: none"><span class="collapsetoggle" style="min-width: 40.4688px;">[<span class="jslink" tabindex="0">hide</span>]</span><i><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition" title="Pocket Edition">Pocket Edition</a></i></th></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_1.0.0" title="Pocket Edition 1.0.0">1.0.0</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_alpha_0.17.0.1" title="Pocket Edition alpha 0.17.0.1">alpha 0.17.0.1</a></th>
<td>Added Profile UI option to change between Inventory UI "Pocket" and "Classic (like in <a href="/w/Windows_10_Edition" title="Windows 10 Edition">Windows 10 Edition</a>)".</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="2" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_1.1.0" title="Pocket Edition 1.1.0">1.1.0</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="2"><a href="/w/Pocket_Edition_alpha_1.1.0.0" title="Pocket Edition alpha 1.1.0.0">alpha 1.1.0.0</a></th>
<td>Off-hand slot added.
</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row">
<td>Added the <a href="/w/Game_rule" title="Game rule">game rule</a> <code>keepInventory</code>, allowing for the retention of player inventory upon death when set to <code>true</code>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible collapsible-rows"><th class="historytable-subheader" colspan="8" style="border-bottom: none"><span class="collapsetoggle" style="min-width: 40.4688px;">[<span class="jslink" tabindex="0">hide</span>]</span><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition_version_history" title="Bedrock Edition version history"><i>Bedrock Edition</i></a></th></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition_1.2.0" title="Bedrock Edition 1.2.0">1.2.0</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition_beta_1.2.0.2" title="Bedrock Edition beta 1.2.0.2">beta 1.2.0.2</a></th>
<td>Changed the general look and layout of the inventory, in regards of the <a href="/w/Recipe_book" title="Recipe book">recipe book</a>.</td></tr><tr class="collapsible-row"><th class="nowrap" rowspan="1" colspan="3"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition_1.21.120" title="Bedrock Edition 1.21.120">1.21.120</a></th><th colspan="4" rowspan="1"><a href="/w/Bedrock_Edition_Preview_1.21.120.23" title="Bedrock Edition Preview 1.21.120.23">Preview 1.21.120.23</a></th>
